title: Reaping the Reaper
sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories
description: Persistent deterministic rogue-AI hunt preserving the two-stage operation, broadcast consequence, alternate investigation route, final escape branch and Rules Engine authority.
premise: Major Veronica Stiles hires the Crew to hunt the rogue AI tied to her daughter Jezz's death.
publicBackground: A supposed urban-legend AI called the Reaper is linked to Netrunner deaths and now appears able to weaponize drones and people.
gmBackground: Reaper uses vulnerable Mediaware Braingen Internal Agents to create Biodrones. ReaperA/ReaperB are lesser copies; Reaper Prime is the final target. The AI truth, broadcast consequence and Prime location remain sealed until discovered.

startDefinition.openingSituation: Major Stiles offers 1,000eb per Edgerunner for the first operation: retrieve Faisal's scanner, deliver it to Lieutenant Tanzia and support the hunt.

locations.name: Forlorn Hope
locations.descriptionPublic: The Edgerunner bar where Major Stiles briefs the Crew.
locations.descriptionGM: Stiles' first contract pays 1,000eb each. Later she offers another 2,000eb to collect Faisal's anti-Reaper equipment and join the final hunt.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Upper Marina Docks
locations.descriptionPublic: Cargo docks where Faisal's custom scanner waits in a container.
locations.descriptionGM: After pickup, ReaperB attacks through two Air Swarm Drone Clouds and a Large Air Drone.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Guangbo Tower / Virtex's Virtual Venue
locations.descriptionPublic: A rehabilitating Little China tower whose top-floor virtuality arcade has gone dark.
locations.descriptionGM: The Reaper copy is attempting to connect a NET Architecture to the old radio transmitter. Elevator, stairs, investigation and combat checks remain Rules Engine authority.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Virtex Transmitter Control
locations.descriptionPublic: The old transmitter control center is wired to a hostile NET Architecture.
locations.descriptionGM: ReaperA needs five rounds to broadcast. Crew may disconnect the server, destroy it, or destroy ReaperA in NET Combat. A successful broadcast adds five Biodrones to the final encounter.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Bits'n'Bolts
locations.descriptionPublic: A Pacifica Playground repair and salvage shop holding Faisal's anti-Reaper gear.
locations.descriptionGM: Pickup contains three Scramblers, two EMP Grenades and one Wrist-Mounted Reaper Detector.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Mister Rice Guy
locations.descriptionPublic: Netwatch agent Dan Renzer asks the Crew to talk over lunch.
locations.descriptionGM: Three Biodrones attack during the meeting. Working with Renzer is optional; declining him must not end the mission.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Old Network 54 Roof
locations.descriptionPublic: The damaged Hot Zone tower still carries a satellite receiver capable of a citywide scan.
locations.descriptionGM: DV13 Athletics opens the panel; DV15 Electronics/Security connects detector; radiation and boarding checks belong to Rules Engine. Alternative investigation may bypass this location.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: MindNutz Lover
locations.descriptionPublic: A closed braindance club in South Night City where the hunt converges.
locations.descriptionGM: Reaper Prime resides in a backpack NET Architecture worn by the Biodrone DJ. Destroy Prime via NET Combat or destroy the architecture. If the DJ escapes, use Reaper Unreaped.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Resolution
locations.descriptionPublic: The Crew returns to the Hope after the assault.
locations.descriptionGM: Both At the Hope and Reaper Unreaped are valid persistent endings. Failure to destroy Prime is not rewritten into success.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Major Veronica Stiles
npcs.personality: Controlled, driven and personal about the hunt.
npcs.motivation: Destroy the AI responsible for Jezz's death.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Runs the operation as a personal mission.
npcs.secretKnowledge: Her team believes lesser Reaper copies exist and later identifies the Braingen exploit.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Do not expose later intelligence before the first operation is analyzed.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Lieutenant Tanzia
npcs.publicKnowledge: Takes custody of the scanner and leads the first hunt.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Protect Sall3 during transmitter fight while Crew retains tactical agency.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Sall3 Smite
npcs.publicKnowledge: Operates the scanner and provides technical support.
npcs.secretKnowledge: Analysis reveals the Braingen vulnerability and later confirms Prime's destruction.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Automatic successes explicitly granted by source are allowed; otherwise Rules Engine owns checks.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Faisal
npcs.publicKnowledge: Provides scanner, later Scramblers, EMP grenades and detector.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Equipment quantities are deterministic inventory facts.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Dan Renzer
npcs.motivation: Prove and stop the rogue AI pattern.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Investigates seventeen suspicious Netrunner fatalities off the books.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Crew may work with him or decline; do not gate mission completion on alliance.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Marianne Freeman
npcs.motivation: Support Edgerunners and settle Stiles' payments.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Handles the promised payments at the Hope.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Pay authored outcomes; never turn escape into victory.

clues.title: Jezz and the Reaper rumor
clues.information: DV13 Deduction, Education, Library Search or Local Expert can connect Jezz Stiles' death to rumors of the Reaper.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Faisal's Reaper scanner
clues.information: The custom scanner detects Reaper activity over a limited area.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Mediaware Braingen exploit
clues.information: Reaper can tunnel into a common Mediaware Braingen Internal Agent and directly control victims as Biodrones.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Anti-Reaper equipment
clues.information: Faisal supplies three Scramblers, two EMP Grenades and one wrist detector.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Renzer's fatality pattern
clues.information: Renzer found seventeen suspicious Netrunner deaths and evidence victims described a digital entity called the Reaper.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Reaper Prime coordinates
clues.information: The trail resolves to MindNutz Lover in South Night City. If Renzer is declined, Stiles/Sall3 or the Combat Cabb trail can provide an alternate route.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Lesser Reaper copies
secrets.information: ReaperA/ReaperB are lesser copies; the true target is Reaper Prime.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Braingen vulnerability
secrets.information: A security flaw in Mediaware Braingen lets Reaper create Biodrones.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Broadcast reinforcement consequence
secrets.information: If ReaperA completes the transmitter broadcast, add five Biodrones to the final encounter.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Prime location
secrets.information: Reaper Prime is at MindNutz Lover.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Prime architecture
secrets.information: Reaper Prime is inside the backpack NET Architecture worn by the Biodrone DJ.

objectives.description: Complete the first hunt, trace Reaper Prime and resolve the final assault without allowing narration to invent mechanical outcomes.
